title: Ya Ali Moosa Reza
body:
Hai Ali(as)naam laqab apka hamraz e khuda
Ya Ali moosa reza(as)
Ya Ali moosa reza(as) ya Ali moosa reza(as) ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tere darbaar ki ausaaf juda hai maula(as)...
Hai'n khade moosa (as)kahi'n par to kahi'n par esa (as)...
Arsh walon ka thikana hai haram tera bana... ya Ali(as) moosa reza(as)
2.Har shab o roz malaik bhi sawali bankar...
Tere darbaar se lene ko hai'n aatey langar...
Khwan e jannat se bhi aala hai tere dar ki ghiza.... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mojeza aapka ye bhi hai jaha'n me mashhor..
Bistar_e_ margh pe bhi ho to maraz hota hai dur..
Zindagi banta hai aapka yun sehne shifa... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bhool jaaye ye zamana na kahi'n baghe fidak...
Bat ke rouze se tere aaj bhi kehta hai namak (salt)...
Khaa raha hai jo zamana hai wo haqqe zahra (as).... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tapte sehra me rawan aab nahi'n dekha kahi'n...
Mera iman hai is baat pe beshak hai yaqeen...
Ism tera zabeeh Allah ke lab par hoga.... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aap ke hath ki rab jaane kya azmat hogi...
Jabke deta hai shifa neesha me sabko paani (water)...
Aapke qadmon ke niche se jo tha jaari hua... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ghair mumkin hai ke radd baat ye karde koi...
Koi zawwar tere dar se jo laaya roti...
Ghaib se rozi aata tune ose ki maula.... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Laa walad lene gaya phool agar sehne ghadeer...
Jhooliyan bhar gayi uski ba tufaile besheer(as)...
Hui maqbool dua saal na tha pura hua... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Bandh kar dahine baazu (right hand) me imame zamin...
Kehke ye ghar se nikalte hai'n safar par momeen...
Har balaon se bachayenge hamen maula Raza(as)... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Aaye zawwaron se milne ke liye waali e toos(as)....
Maine mashhad me kayi baar kiya hai mehsoos...
Jab kabhi aapke rouze se chali thandi hawa... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Din chadh dhoop me jab chaa gaye kaale badal
Dekha hai maine machi thi waha'n kaisi hal chal...
Thama toofan tha uthi thi jo naubat ki sada.... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Har dafa aapke rouze pe haya! ne ki dua...
Ho ata usko bhi sadqa_e_sukhan debal ka...
Ospe hoti rahe khallaq_e_ do aalam ki ata... ya Ali moosa reza(as)
